limitations: No global statement about Filippov cycles containing sliding segments, tangent switching trajectories, other two-zone affine coefficient families or full-plane basins. scientific_integrity: The published algebraic level-set equations are used as evidence, and all dynamical orientation and sliding conclusions are independently derived from the displayed vector fields; only the crossing version of periodic orbits is excluded.
title: A one-way crossing barrier and exact sliding capture in a two-saddle affine switch
